title: Content
description: A long-form prose section for a landing, guide or article page, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a kicker, a serif heading and a lead, then titled sections of paragraphs on the contract type scale, a pulled quote and one call to action, in one reading column capped at --container-md, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the lead steps up at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the section gets more room above and below at @lg.
